settings.heading: Tell us what you're building
settings.intro: Questions about a theme, help with setup, or a custom Shopify store from scratch — it all lands with the people who design and build our themes.
settings.note: Every message is read by a person, not a bot.
settings.topics: Custom theme, Theme support, Buying a theme, Something else
settings.success: Thanks — your message is in. We'll get back to you by email.
settings.q1: I bought a theme. How do I get help?
settings.a1: Choose “Theme support” above and include your store URL and order number, plus a screenshot if something looks wrong.
settings.q2: How does a custom theme project work?
settings.a2: Tell us about your brand, products and goals. We'll reply with questions, ideas and a quote before any work starts.
settings.q3: Can you set up a theme on my store?
settings.a3: Yes. Setup help is included with our setup package — pick “Buying a theme” and tell us what you need.
settings.q4: What should I include in my message?
settings.a4: Your store URL, what you'd like to change or build, and any deadlines. Links to stores you like help a lot.
